page_title: WOL 1-1 HEI | Wolfsburg v Heidenheim 17/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' A clumsy foul by Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Heidenheim) and Tobias Welz blows his whistle.
90+5' Heidenheim take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

90+4' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) takes a nice touch on the edge of the box as he meets a pass and produces a shot towards the roof of the net. What an excellent save by the goalkeeper! Heidenheim force a corner. They send men into the box.
90+4' Adam Daghim (Wolfsburg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
90+2' Jesper Lindstrom (Wolfsburg) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the middle of the goal, but Diant Ramaj is equal to it and makes an easy save.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' The referee allows time for a substitution. Mathias Honsak will be replaced by Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim).
89' The referee shows a yellow card to Jesper Lindstrom (Wolfsburg). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
89' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
88' Sael Kumbedi (Wolfsburg) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Wolfsburg will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
88' The corner is swung in but Heidenheim can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

87' Leonidas Stergiou (Heidenheim) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. It will be a corner kick for Heidenheim.
86' Here is a change. Niklas Dorsch is going off and Frank Schmidt gives the last tactical orders to Luca Kerber (Heidenheim).
86' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Heidenheim) is coming onto the pitch as Marvin Pieringer cannot continue after picking up an injury.
84' Adam Daghim (Wolfsburg) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.

80' 1 - 1 Moritz Jenz (Wolfsburg) jumps highest in the box to meet the resulting corner from Christian Eriksen. His header flies towards the top right corner and bounces in off the post, giving the goalkeeper no chance. The score is 1:1.
80' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) will deliver the corner kick.

80' Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Wolfsburg will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
78' The attendance for today's match is 19361.
77' Frank Schmidt has decided to substitute Jonas Fohrenbach and he is replaced by Leonidas Stergiou (Heidenheim).
77' Here comes a substitution. Adrian Beck is given a rest as he is replaced by Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim).

76' Adam Daghim (Wolfsburg) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat. Good work from Wolfsburg as they win a corner.
76' Wolfsburg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
75' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
74' Now Wolfsburg have a corner. Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
70' Substitution. Yannick Gerhardt did his best and is replaced by Jesper Lindstrom (Wolfsburg).
68' Whoa! Such gestures are commonly penalised and Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) duly receives a yellow card.
68' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

68' Sael Kumbedi (Wolfsburg) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat. Wolfsburg get a corner.
67' Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Kamil Grabara intercepts the ball.
65' Adam Daghim (Wolfsburg) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
65' Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) brings his opponent down. Tobias Welz has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
63' Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
62' Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
60' The resulting set piece from Heidenheim is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. Heidenheim have been awarded a corner kick.
59' Daniel Bauer prepares a substitution. Lovro Majer is replaced by Adam Daghim (Wolfsburg).
59' It is time for a substitution. Sael Kumbedi (Wolfsburg) is on for Jan Burger.
59' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
58' The yellow card is received by Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim).
57' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) swings it in and Mohamed Amoura gets on the end of it, but Diant Ramaj shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.

56' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards the right side of the goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper with a stunning save.
54' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Diant Ramaj comes off the line to clear the ball away.
53' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Diant Ramaj has no trouble gathering it.
52' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Wolfsburg win a corner.
50' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
50' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Wolfsburg comes to nothing. The referee signals a corner kick to Wolfsburg.

49' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the right side of the target that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance. The linesman makes the right call and Wolfsburg will have a corner.
46' Daniel Bauer makes a switch. Kevin Paredes is coming on in place of Aaron Zehnter (Wolfsburg) at the start of the second period.
46' The whistle blows and Tobias Welz starts the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' 0 - 1 Goal! Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 0:1.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' The resulting corner from Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) is cleared by the defence.
44' A cross from Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. Heidenheim force their opponents to concede a corner.
43' Close! Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.
41' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) sprays a pass out to Mohamed Amoura, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
40' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
39' Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) serves up a nice cross, but Kamil Grabara punches the ball away.
37' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg).
36' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg). The referee points to the corner flag and Wolfsburg will take a corner.

36' Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score low in the middle of the goal, but great anticipation by Kamil Grabara allowed him to make a comfortable save.
35' Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Kamil Grabara, who smothers the ball.
34' The ball possession at the moment is 69:31.
32' The free kick is delivered by Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
32' Arijon Ibrahimovic (Heidenheim) brings an opponent down and Tobias Welz interrupts the game. There is a free kick near the sideline to Wolfsburg.
31' Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) gets on the end of a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but it's a poor header and drifts high over the bar.
29' Diant Ramaj makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded by Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) after a cross from the side.
29' Tobias Welz shows a yellow card to Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) for his blatant foul.
28' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) is caught offside!
26' Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Tobias Welz had an easy-decision to make.

24' Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) gathers a nice lofted pass just outside the box and attempts to put the ball low inside the right post, but his shot is deflected away by one of the defending players.
24' Christian Eriksen (Wolfsburg) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
21' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) misses a great chance! He latches on to a fine cross into the box, but his effort misses the right post by a whisker.
21' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
20' Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) runs onto a pass and from the edge of the box tries his luck with a dipping shot. Unfortunately for him, the effort fizzes just over the bar.
19' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) beautifully controls an overhit pass, beats an opponent but hits a weak shot at goal that sails well wide of the left post.
17' Aaron Zehnter (Wolfsburg) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
16' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) was quite harsh and Tobias Welz didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

13' Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
11' Referee Tobias Welz sees the trip by Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
10' Niklas Dorsch (Heidenheim) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
7' Jan Burger (Wolfsburg) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The ball is behind the touchline and Wolfsburg will take a throw-in.
5' The ball is cleared after Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
3' Jan Burger (Wolfsburg) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
3' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Wolfsburg will take the kick-off.
Tobias Welz is introduced as the referee for today's match.
